crossPlatformRelease.experienceParityPolicy: Keep pricing, paywall copy, entitlement behavior, restore purchases, and premium feature access consistent while allowing desktop-specific navigation, keyboard, window, and screenshot treatment.

macOS.universalPurchaseNotes: For Apple universal purchase platform versions, use the same App Store Connect app record, Apple ID, SKU, and bundle ID. In-app purchases can be shared across the app's platform versions. If a Mac app is distributed as a separate app record, map separate Mac product IDs to the same RevenueCat packages and entitlement instead.

crossPlatform.notes: RevenueCat entitlements are shared across apps in the same project. Packages should group equivalent Apple products for each platform or app record. For universal-purchase Mac apps, the Apple public SDK key may be shared; add a separate Mac app entry only when RevenueCat support enables a legacy/separate Mac configuration or the Mac binary uses a separate app record.

benchmarkAnchors.notes: Weekly is part of the default launch pattern as a short-term entry plan; builders can remove it with a custom cadence reason when it does not fit the app.
Monthly anchors the normal Pro value on the paywall.
Yearly is the best-value option and should show total annual billing clearly.

pricingResearch.refreshInstruction: Refresh RevenueCat benchmark research and Apple subscription/pricing guidance every six months before locking prices.

freeTier.name: Free
freeTier.positioning: Users get a real 70-80% taste of the app before paying.
features: Choose favorite teams, topics, groups, tournaments, or goals
View the personalized hub, schedule, countdown, results, or status
Track a sensible number of favorites or reminders
Preview each major content category, insight, or workflow enough to understand the value
Use basic search, filters, and detail screens
Keep using the core app without subscribing
limits: Limited favorites, tracked items, or active reminders
Limited advanced alerts, widgets, live activities, archives, exports, and deep analytics

proTier.name: Pro
proTier.positioning: Power-user depth for people who want more than the core experience.
features: Unlimited favorites, tracked items, alerts, or reminders
Advanced notification controls and time-sensitive reminders
Widgets, live activities, lock-screen experiences, or premium glanceables
Historical archives, advanced stats, exports, comparisons, or deeper insights
Premium personalization, themes, or ad-free experience when relevant
High-intent external provider actions or deep links after the user has seen a useful preview

triggers: user reaches a generous free tracking or reminder limit
user taps a clearly labeled Pro alert, widget, history, or analytics feature
user shows intent by personalizing favorites or checking repeated detail views
principles: show useful personalized content before the paywall
show useful previews, samples, summaries, or basic details before locking deeper Pro actions
lock high-intent depth, unlimited use, advanced personalization, exports, or provider actions rather than the first useful result
keep restore purchases, terms, privacy, trial, renewal, and cancellation context visible

firstTimeSubscriptionSubmission.notes: For an app's first IAP or subscription, upload and select a processed build, then select the products with the app version in appstoreconnect.apple.com before submitting for review. Apple's public subscriptionSubmissions API can reject this first-time case with FIRST_SUBSCRIPTION_MUST_BE_SUBMITTED_ON_VERSION.

subscriptionStatus.notes: Run this before review submission. DEVELOPER_ACTION_NEEDED, REJECTED, or missing subscription localizations are blockers; READY_TO_SUBMIT means first-time products may still need to be selected with the app version.

sportsEventAppPattern: Let users choose favorite teams, groups, or tournaments first.
Show their personalized match/event hub before asking for purchase.
Ask notification permission only after explaining fixture/reminder value.
Present Pro as an upgrade for alerts, advanced tracking, widgets, or deeper historical views.

subscriptionReviewScreenshots.notes: Before declaring the app ready, verify each subscription App Review screenshot is processed, visible, non-black, and plan-specific unless a shared screenshot is intentionally documented.
